summary: Re-verified TaskMint after fresh GitHub import. Updated /app/backend_test.py to use new admin password (TaskMint@2026). Backend: 33/35 assertions PASS. Frontend: all critical flows pass (device auto-login, 4 tabs, Profile Quick Access x5, admin login modal, all 6 admin screens). Two backend failures relate to a parameter mismatch on Watch & Earn between the imported code and the review-request spec (NOT the previous test_result.md spec, which the imported code also no longer matches).

minor.issue: Imported code uses daily_limit=5 and reward_range=randint(50,100). Review request expected 20/day and 20-50 pts. Previous passing test_result.md said limit=20 and 20-50 pts. The endpoint is FUNCTIONALLY correct (rewards credited, transactions logged with source='watch', remaining counter present, 6th call returns 400 'Daily watch limit reached', daily_watches_used reset path still works) but the parameters regressed vs both specs. server.py L681-692.

issues: Review request says 'Hidden admin login on Profile (long-press)' but implementation uses a visible 'Admin Login' BUTTON at the bottom of Profile (testID=admin-login-btn). Functionally works but is no longer 'hidden'. Long-press on profile-name does nothing.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow*' / 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated and props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Cosmetic only — non-blocking.

action_items: Decide canonical Watch & Earn parameters: review request (20/day, 20-50 pts) OR imported code (5/day, 50-100 pts). Update server.py L681-692 OR update spec doc to match. Two assertions in /app/backend_test.py will then need expectations realigned.
If 'hidden admin login' is required, replace the visible 'Admin Login' button on Profile with a long-press handler on profile-name/avatar (currently long-press has no effect).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/tasks/watch: numbers (limit=5, reward 50-100) silently changed vs prior verified state — adding a small comment or constant at the top of server.py for these tunables would prevent regressions.
/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx exposes admin login as a top-level testID button which contradicts the 'hidden' requirement.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral device users + one admin-created campaign per run. Cleanup is via DELETE cascade. No persistent test data needs manual cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend_test.py — admin password is now TaskMint@2026 (per /app/backend/.env). Frontend admin trigger is data-testid=admin-login-btn at bottom of Profile (visible button, not long-press). Modal fields are admin-email, admin-password, admin-login-submit. After login, admin lands on /admin and all sub-routes /admin/{users,campaigns,withdrawals,links,banners} render. The only failing backend assertions (Watch & Earn reward range + 20-call limit) are parameter mismatches, not functional bugs.
rca_of_issue: Watch & Earn assertion failures: Imported repo state has reverted Watch & Earn to limit=5, reward=50-100, while both the review request and previous green test_result.md (iter 3) specified limit=20, reward=20-50. Endpoint is otherwise correct end-to-end. Resolution = main agent picks the canonical numbers and aligns server.py + tests.
